analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold from 31.8 to 41.6, MACD histogram also improves from -0.4524 to 0.2467 signaling bottoming. However, price remains below SMA50($70.68) and EMA50($69.25) resistance, lacking conviction for trend reversal. Low volume ratio (0.83) over 5 days indicates weak buying interest. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
